_comment: What collect.landed() returns, captured in the shape lamin_api produces. Paired with
declared/ so that the two deliberately disagree: source_core_uid was declared and did not
land, bgnorm_attempts landed as float where int was declared, the Patient type was deleted
and recreated under a new uid, the Core type never landed, and bgnormed_image landed with
nobody declaring it. parent_sample landed under a uid-pinned dtype while its declaration
names the bare registry Sample, which the registries below do not enumerate, so the
reviewer cannot confirm the expected spelling and must not claim drift.
The registries list carries bionty.Protein because marker_target is declared against it and
that declaration IS confirmable, which is the half of the pair that must still match.
values_incomplete is lamin_api's own statement that it read the WHOLE permitted-value list,
which is the only thing that can say so: it caps each part of a dtype and then deduplicates,
so a truncated list comes back shorter than the cap and the length proves nothing.
connection is the endpoint that answered, and it is the control-plane VM's own shape:
the host is the postgres container because LAMIN_DB_HOST_OVERRIDE rewrites it there.
It carries no password because lamin_api never reads one, which the page asserts.
